stages.name: sigmoid4_vec
stages.description: Q8.8 -> clamp[-4,4) -> addr=x+1024 -> Q0.16 ROM output.
notes: Best first stage for cocotb bit-exact verification.
Should match RTL clamp, ROM address, and Q0.16 output exactly.

stages.name: ew_update_vec4
stages.description: State update s_new = lam*s_prev + (1-lam)*u with SRAM timing.
notes: Must align lam Q0.16 -> Q8.8 truncation, one_minus, SRAM read latency, and write-back address.

stages.name: top_mac_plus_bias_fifo_sigmoid_ew_gate
stages.description: SSM post-dt path including bias, sigmoid, EW update, and gate.
notes: Good integration target after sigmoid4_vec and ew_update_vec4 pass.

stages.name: reuse_ssm_core
stages.description: Standalone SSM post-dt core: bias -> sigmoid -> join -> EW update -> gate.
notes: Current simulation model of bias_add_regslice_ip_A uses zero-initialized bias mem_sim unless TB explicitly initializes it.
This stage isolates dt/lam/ssm/gate from the top-level scheduler.

stages.name: reuse_ssm_dt_scheduler
stages.description: Standalone dt scheduler with shared MAC fabric and u_act SRAM source.
notes: This stage isolates dt GEMV + xt FIFO wavefront from top-level ownership switching.
Use it to determine whether dt mismatch originates in the scheduler itself or in top-level integration.

stages.name: reuse_mamba_block_top
stages.description: Block-level top around shared MAC fabric.
notes: Use only after in_proj and SSM subpaths are individually validated.
Current top-level y golden is the block-local out_proj result before any residual add outside this RTL block.
Top compare targets internal SRAM / subpath outputs and the final out_proj y stream/SRAM.
